entries.en: The icy rain chilled us to the marrow before we reached the shelter.
entries.zh: 我们还没走到避雨处，冰冷的雨就把我们冻透了。

entries.en: Even with the volume turned to the maximum, we could barely hear the recording.
entries.zh: 即使把音量调到最大，我们也几乎听不清录音。

entries.en: The tiny guest room had been polished and decorated to the nth degree.
entries.zh: 那间小客房被擦拭、装饰到了极致。

entries.en: Her comments were brief and to the point, unlike the chairman's rambling speech.
entries.zh: 她的评论简短中肯，不像主席的讲话那样东拉西扯。

entries.en: His casual dismissal of her painting cut her to the quick.
entries.zh: 他对她的画随口表示不屑，深深刺痛了她。

entries.en: The once-favoured adviser left the palace under a cloud in the final chapter.
entries.zh: 最后一章中，那位曾经受宠的顾问失意地离开了王宫。

entries.en: We spent our first night under canvas listening to rain patter on the roof.
entries.zh: 我们第一次住帐篷的那晚，听着雨点打在帐篷顶上的声音。

entries.en: The pony was finally under control, and the children stopped backing away.
entries.zh: 小马终于被控制住了，孩子们也不再往后退。

entries.en: The detective stayed under cover while her partner searched the deserted platform.
entries.zh: 侦探藏着没有露面，她的搭档则搜查了空无一人的站台。

entries.en: The original sketches remained under lock and key throughout the exhibition.
entries.zh: 展览期间，那些素描原作一直被锁着妥善保管。

entries.en: In the novel, apprentices must keep the workshop's secrets under pain of dismissal.
entries.zh: 小说中，学徒必须保守工坊的秘密，违者会被解雇。

entries.en: She noticed that the bond was trading under par and checked its face value.
entries.zh: 她注意到那只债券的交易价格低于票面价值，便查看了它的面值。

entries.en: The little boat was already under sail when we waved from the harbour wall.
entries.zh: 我们在港口防波堤上挥手时，小船已经扬帆起航了。

entries.en: In the play, a royal order under seal arrives during the feast.
entries.zh: 剧中，宴会进行时送来了一道盖有御印的王命。

entries.en: The young orchestra rehearsed under the aegis of a local arts association.
entries.zh: 那支年轻的管弦乐队在当地艺术协会的支持下排练。

entries.en: Several clubs joined forces under the banner of a cleaner neighbourhood.
entries.zh: 几个俱乐部以清洁社区为共同旗帜，联合行动起来。

entries.en: The battered rocking horse went under the hammer after standing in our attic for years.
entries.zh: 那匹破旧的摇马在我们阁楼放了多年后，被拿去拍卖了。

entries.en: Under the influence of her painting teacher, she began experimenting with larger canvases.
entries.zh: 受绘画老师的影响，她开始尝试在更大的画布上作画。

entries.en: In the final scene, the injured sailor goes under the knife while his friends wait outside.
entries.zh: 最后一幕中，受伤的水手接受手术，朋友们则在外面等候。

entries.en: The fictional town falls under the sway of a charming but dishonest mayor.
entries.zh: 那个虚构的小镇落入一位有魅力却不诚实的市长的掌控。

entries.en: The film's crooked auctioneer accepts money under the table to favour certain buyers.
entries.zh: 影片中，那个不诚实的拍卖师私下收钱，偏袒某些买家。

entries.en: The garden gate will remain shut until further notice because the hinge is broken.
entries.zh: 花园大门的铰链坏了，将一直关闭，直至另行通知。

entries.en: With two hours left, the builders were up against a serious shortage of timber.
entries.zh: 只剩两个小时时，建筑工人们面临着木材严重不足的问题。

entries.en: Only two committee members are up for re-election this year.
entries.zh: 今年只有两名委员会成员将参加连任选举。

entries.en: Three places in the summer orchestra are still up for grabs.
entries.zh: 夏季管弦乐队仍有三个名额可供争取。

entries.en: We would be up the creek if the last delivery van broke down.
entries.zh: 要是最后那辆送货车也坏了，我们就麻烦了。

entries.meaningZh: 陷入困境；告吹〔英式非正式用语〕
entries.en: Our weekend plans were up the spout after the campsite flooded.
entries.zh: 营地被淹后，我们的周末计划泡汤了。

entries.en: The repaired door still was not up to the mark and scraped against the floor.
entries.zh: 修过的门仍不合格，开关时会刮到地板。

entries.en: Upwards of fifty neighbours arrived to help paint the village hall.
entries.zh: 五十多位邻居来帮忙粉刷村里的礼堂。

entries.meaningZh: 诸如此类；等等〔非正式用语〕
entries.en: The cupboard was full of ribbons, buttons, old badges and what have you.
entries.zh: 橱柜里塞满了丝带、纽扣、旧徽章之类的东西。

entries.en: What with the rain and the delayed bus, we missed the opening song.
entries.zh: 又是下雨，又是公交车延误，我们错过了开场的歌。

entries.meaningZh: 那个叫什么名字的男人〔非正式用语〕
entries.en: Didn't whatshisname leave a blue scarf on the back of this chair?
entries.zh: 那个叫什么来着的男人，是不是在这把椅背上落了一条蓝围巾？

entries.en: The door slammed with a bang, startling the sleeping cat.
entries.zh: 门砰的一声关上，吓了正在睡觉的猫一跳。

entries.en: The rain returned with a vengeance just as we carried the tables outside.
entries.zh: 我们刚把桌子搬到外面，雨又猛烈地下了起来。

entries.en: They measured the empty loft with a view to turning it into a studio.
entries.zh: 他们丈量了空阁楼，打算把它改成工作室。

entries.en: The volunteers set to work with a will, clearing the overgrown path before lunch.
entries.zh: 志愿者们干劲十足地开始干活，午饭前就清理出了杂草丛生的小路。

entries.en: He handed over the missing key with bad grace and turned away.
entries.zh: 他不情愿地交出了那把失踪的钥匙，转过身去。

entries.en: We watched with bated breath as the child crossed the stage carrying the glass vase.
entries.zh: 孩子捧着玻璃花瓶穿过舞台时，我们屏住呼吸看着。

entries.en: The young pony passed its first training assessment with flying colours.
entries.zh: 那匹小马出色地通过了第一次训练考核。

entries.en: She accepted the last-minute change with good grace and rearranged the flowers.
entries.zh: 她欣然接受了最后一刻的改动，重新摆放了花。

entries.en: The children shouted with one voice when asked whether they wanted another story.
entries.zh: 被问到是否还想再听一个故事时，孩子们异口同声地叫了起来。

entries.en: The drama club welcomed the new costume designer with open arms.
entries.zh: 戏剧社热情地欢迎了新来的服装设计师。

entries.en: I am writing with reference to the parcel left outside our workshop yesterday.
entries.zh: 我写信是想谈谈昨天放在我们工坊外的那个包裹。

entries.en: With regard to the broken window, the caretaker has already ordered new glass.
entries.zh: 关于那扇破窗户，管理员已经订了新玻璃。

entries.en: The young musicians listened with respect when the elderly conductor offered advice.
entries.zh: 年迈的指挥提出建议时，年轻的乐手们恭敬地聆听。

entries.en: We agreed on the design but disagreed with respect to the cost.
entries.zh: 我们在设计上达成了一致，但在费用方面有分歧。

entries.en: Every suitcase was labelled, with the exception of the small red one.
entries.zh: 每只手提箱都贴了标签，只有那只红色的小箱子例外。

entries.en: You may rearrange the furniture within reason, but please leave the piano where it is.
entries.zh: 你可以在合理范围内重新摆放家具，但请别挪动钢琴。

entries.en: Without a doubt, the tiny dog was the loudest member of our walking group.
entries.zh: 毫无疑问，那只小狗是我们步行小组里最吵闹的一员。

entries.en: The tired volunteers carried the extra boxes upstairs without a murmur.
entries.zh: 疲惫的志愿者们毫无怨言地把多出的箱子搬上了楼。

entries.en: We shortened the final scene without detriment to the story's ending.
entries.zh: 我们缩短了最后一场戏，却没有损害故事结尾的效果。

entries.en: The children, without exception, chose the largest slice of cake available.
entries.zh: 孩子们无一例外，都挑了能拿到的最大块蛋糕。

entries.en: Please return the borrowed lantern before sunset tomorrow without fail.
entries.zh: 请务必在明天日落前归还借来的灯笼。

entries.en: Without further ado, the conductor raised her baton and the rehearsal began.
entries.zh: 指挥不再耽搁，举起了指挥棒，排练随即开始。

entries.en: Under the fictional contract, she may lend the costumes without prejudice to the club's ownership.
entries.zh: 根据那份虚构合约，她可以把服装借出去，但不得损害俱乐部的所有权。

entries.en: This is without question the heaviest suitcase I have ever carried.
entries.zh: 毫无疑问，这是我提过的最重的手提箱。

entries.en: The old bell rang at odd hours, apparently without rhyme or reason.
entries.zh: 那口旧钟会在奇怪的时刻响起，似乎毫无规律可循。

entries.en: The person who forgot to bring the tickets was yours truly.
entries.zh: 那个忘带票的人，就是我本人。

entries.en: Aside from a scratched corner, the mirror arrived in perfect condition.
entries.zh: 除了一个角被划伤了，那面镜子送到时完好无损。

entries.en: The two gardeners lent each other tools throughout the summer.
entries.zh: 整个夏天，两位园丁都互相借工具用。

entries.en: I left in a hurry and accidentally took the wrong umbrella.
entries.zh: 我匆忙离开，不小心拿错了雨伞。

entries.en: The woman in charge of the costumes kept every button in a labelled jar.
entries.zh: 负责服装的女士把每一颗纽扣都放在贴有标签的罐子里。

entries.en: Although the rehearsal looked chaotic, the director was firmly in control.
entries.zh: 虽然排练看起来一片混乱，导演却牢牢掌控着局面。

entries.en: The choir planted a rose bush in memory of its former conductor.
entries.zh: 合唱团种下了一株玫瑰，以纪念从前的指挥。

entries.en: The travellers helped one another lift their bags onto the high luggage rack.
entries.zh: 旅客们互相帮助，把包举到高高的行李架上。

entries.en: Small objects such as buttons and coins kept slipping between the floorboards.
entries.zh: 纽扣、硬币之类的小东西不断掉进地板缝里。

entries.meaningZh: 以某人难堪或受损为代价
entries.en: The teasing stopped being funny when everyone began laughing at Leo's expense.
entries.zh: 当大家开始拿利奥取笑时，那些逗弄就不再好笑了。

entries.en: On the subject of lunch, has anyone found the missing picnic basket?
entries.zh: 说到午饭，有谁找到那个不见了的野餐篮了吗？

entries.en: Maria folded her damp coat over a chair and joined us beside the fire.
entries.zh: 玛丽亚把湿外套搭在椅子上，来到炉火旁和我们待在一起。

entries.en: A Hereford leaned over the fence while the farmer filled the water trough.
entries.zh: 农夫往水槽里加水时，一头赫里福德牛探出了围栏。

entries.en: Two students stayed after the lecture to ask further questions about cDNA.
entries.zh: 两名学生在讲座结束后留了下来，继续询问有关互补DNA的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 科次窝德绵羊〔绵羊品种〕
entries.en: The shepherd led a reluctant Cotswold through the gate before closing it.
entries.zh: 牧羊人牵着一只不情愿的科次窝德绵羊穿过大门，然后关上了门。

entries.en: An Ayrshire stood quietly in the yard while its calf explored the empty bucket.
entries.zh: 一头艾尔夏牛静静地站在院里，它的小牛犊则探看着空桶。

entries.en: Her diagram of mRNA occupied the entire whiteboard, leaving no space for my notes.
entries.zh: 她画的信使核糖核酸示意图占满了整块白板，没有给我的笔记留空间。

entries.en: She borrowed a county history of Pembroke while preparing the family photograph exhibition.
entries.zh: 她筹备家庭照片展时，借来了一本彭布罗克郡的郡史。

entries.en: The costume designer chose Kendal green for the forester's cloak in the historical play.
entries.zh: 服装设计师选用肯德尔绿色粗呢，为那部历史剧中的护林人制作斗篷。

entries.en: Emilia found her missing glove inside the rolled-up picnic blanket.
entries.zh: 伊米莉亚在卷起来的野餐毯里找到了丢失的手套。

entries.en: We spent the rainy afternoon assembling a paper model of tRNA.
entries.zh: 那个下雨的下午，我们一直在拼装转移核糖核酸的纸模型。

entries.meaningZh: 克里内克丝面巾纸〔商标〕
entries.en: She pulled a Kleenex from the box and wiped the spilled tea off her glasses.
entries.zh: 她从盒里抽出一张克里内克丝面巾纸，擦掉了眼镜上溅的茶水。

entries.en: Our photograph of Exmoor was too blurred to include in the exhibition.
entries.zh: 我们那张埃克斯穆尔高地的照片太模糊了，不能放进展览。

entries.en: The gardener moved the Echinacea away from the path before visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 游客到来前，园丁把那株松果菊属植物移到了远离小路的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 波托克斯〔肉毒杆菌毒素制剂商品名〕
entries.en: The seminar on Botox ended before anyone could ask the visiting speaker a question.
entries.zh: 关于波托克斯的研讨会结束了，大家还没来得及向来访讲者提问。

entries.en: A Dorking wandered into the shed and knocked over the empty seed tray.
entries.zh: 一只杜金鸡走进棚子，碰翻了空的育苗盘。

entries.en: The farmer caught the escaped Dominique beside the wheelbarrow.
entries.zh: 农夫在手推车旁抓住了那只跑出来的多米尼加鸡。

entries.en: A fallen branch had crushed a young Ficus tree in the courtyard.
entries.zh: 一根落下的树枝压坏了院里的一株无花果属幼树。

entries.en: The Brahmin in the novel refuses the merchant's gift and leaves the courtyard.
entries.zh: 小说中，那位婆罗门拒绝了商人的礼物，离开了庭院。

entries.meaningZh: 可变方向图的多元菱形天线〔旧电信术语〕
entries.en: The faded photograph of the Musa antenna array was too damaged to reproduce clearly.
entries.zh: 那张多元菱形天线阵列的褪色照片破损得太严重，无法清晰地复制。

entries.en: She photographed a specimen of Apis through the glass lid of the display case.
entries.zh: 她隔着陈列柜的玻璃盖，拍摄了一件蜂属标本。

entries.en: The technician set aside the damaged container of EDTA and reported the cracked lid.
entries.zh: 技术员把那只受损的乙二胺四乙酸容器放到一边，并报告了盖子破裂的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 阿比西尼亚的〔旧地区名称相关〕
entries.en: She found an old photograph of an Abyssinian village between the album's loose pages.
entries.zh: 她在相册散落的书页之间发现了一张阿比西尼亚村庄的旧照片。

entries.en: The old poem follows a hungry reynard through a moonlit orchard.
entries.zh: 那首旧诗描写了一只饥饿的狐狸穿过月光下的果园。

entries.en: The student adjusted the lamp to get a clearer view of the Aplysia specimen.
entries.zh: 学生调了调灯，以便更清楚地观察那件雨虎属标本。

entries.en: She carried the potted Brassica into the greenhouse before the hail began.
entries.zh: 冰雹下起来之前，她把盆里的芸苔属植物搬进了温室。

entries.en: Our Orpington refused to leave the porch until the dog had gone indoors.
entries.zh: 我们的奥尔平顿鸡一直不肯离开门廊，直到狗进了屋。

entries.en: An Airedale stretched across the doorway, blocking our way into the kitchen.
entries.zh: 一只艾尔谷犬舒展身体横卧在门口，挡住了我们进厨房的路。

entries.meaningZh: 原生动物门〔旧分类名称〕
entries.en: The librarian repaired a torn plate depicting Protozoa in an old zoology volume.
entries.zh: 图书馆员修补了一本旧动物学书里描绘原生动物门的破损图版。

entries.en: The botanist returned to sketch the Melia after finding her missing notebook.
entries.zh: 植物学家找到丢失的笔记本后，回来给那株楝属植物画素描。

entries.meaningZh: 派热克斯耐热玻璃〔商品名〕
entries.en: He wrapped the Pyrex dish in a towel before packing it beside the plates.
entries.zh: 他先用毛巾裹好那个派热克斯耐热玻璃盘，再把它装在其他盘子旁边。

entries.en: The museum assistant found a damaged specimen of Rana in the bottom drawer.
entries.zh: 博物馆助理在最下面的抽屉里发现了一件受损的蛙属标本。

entries.en: We paused beside the Hypericum while our guide went back for her umbrella.
entries.zh: 导游回去拿伞时，我们在那株金丝桃属植物旁停了下来。

entries.en: The curator lifted the glass cover so we could examine the specimen of Falco.
entries.zh: 馆员抬起玻璃罩，好让我们观察那件隼属标本。

entries.en: His notebook contained careful sketches of Crustacea beside a shopping list for the journey.
entries.zh: 他的笔记本里，旅行购物清单旁画着一些细致的甲壳纲动物素描。

entries.en: The broken pot left the roots of the Eugenia exposed on the greenhouse floor.
entries.zh: 花盆破了，那株番樱桃属植物的根露在温室地板上。

entries.en: A lively discussion of Pseudomonas continued long after the laboratory seminar had ended.
entries.zh: 实验室研讨会结束很久后，关于假单胞菌属的热烈讨论还在继续。

entries.meaningZh: 苏格兰男子〔非正式称呼〕
entries.en: The cheerful Scottie in the story offers the lost traveller a seat by the fire.
entries.zh: 故事中，那位开朗的苏格兰男子请迷路的旅人在火边坐下。

entries.en: The last Nyssa in the nursery stood beside a stack of cracked clay pots.
entries.zh: 苗圃里最后那株紫树属植物立在一摞裂开的陶盆旁边。

entries.en: A young Brahman arrives at the inn carrying a sealed letter in the opening scene.
entries.zh: 开场一幕中，一位年轻的婆罗门带着一封密封的信来到客栈。

entries.en: A row of Abelmoschus seedlings stood beneath the greenhouse's cracked window.
entries.zh: 温室那扇破裂的窗户下面摆着一排秋葵属幼苗。

entries.en: The damaged drawing of Abramis was still detailed enough for the museum display.
entries.zh: 那幅受损的欧鳊属鱼类图画仍足够精细，可以用于博物馆陈列。

entries.en: A visiting researcher borrowed the photographs of Abrocoma for her evening lecture.
entries.zh: 一位来访研究员借走了那些华毛鼠属动物的照片，用于晚上的讲座。

entries.en: Seeds of Abronia spilled across the potting bench when the packet tore.
entries.zh: 包装袋一破，匍匐美女樱属植物的种子就撒满了栽培工作台。

entries.en: We paused the underwater film to examine the Abudefduf near the edge of the frame.
entries.zh: 我们暂停水下影片，仔细看了看画面边缘的那条豆娘鱼属鱼。

entries.en: The gardener rescued a small Acalypha from beneath the fallen shelving.
entries.zh: 园丁从倒下的架子底下救出了一株小小的铁苋菜属植物。

entries.en: The curator moved the specimens of Acanthaceae into a separate cabinet.
entries.zh: 馆长把爵床科标本移进了一个单独的柜子。

entries.en: His sketchbook fell open at a delicate pencil drawing of Acanthisitta.
entries.zh: 他的素描本翻开在一幅细致的刺鹩属鸟铅笔画那一页。

entries.en: We borrowed three books on Acanthisittidae while preparing the bird exhibition.
entries.zh: 筹备鸟类展览时，我们借了三本关于刺鹩科的书。

entries.en: The old zoology text's discussion of Acanthocephala continued on a badly stained page.
entries.zh: 那本旧动物学教科书有关棘头纲的论述，接着写在一张污渍斑斑的书页上。

entries.en: The nursery's last Acanthocereus had outgrown its cracked clay pot.
entries.zh: 苗圃里最后那株刺萼柱属植物已经长得太大，裂开的陶盆装不下了。

entries.en: The museum technician repaired the stand beneath the mounted Acanthocybium specimen.
entries.zh: 博物馆技术员修好了那件刺鲅属装架标本下面的支架。

entries.en: The zoologist's lecture on Acanthophis drew more questions than the chair had expected.
entries.zh: 动物学家关于棘蛇属的讲座引来了比主持人预想更多的问题。

entries.en: She spent the morning photographing the museum's small collection of Acanthoscelides specimens.
entries.zh: 她花了一上午拍摄博物馆收藏的那一小批三齿豆象属标本。

entries.en: A leaking roof had damaged the album of Acanthuridae photographs.
entries.zh: 屋顶漏水，损坏了那本刺尾鱼科鱼类的影集。

entries.en: The diver's clearest photograph showed an Acanthurus beside a broken anchor.
entries.zh: 潜水员拍得最清楚的那张照片里，一条刺尾鱼属鱼在一只破锚旁边。

entries.en: He compared the old illustrations of Acaridae under a bright desk lamp.
entries.zh: 他在明亮的台灯下对照着那些螨科动物的旧插图。

entries.en: The specialist brought several old monographs on Acarina to the seminar.
entries.zh: 那位专家带了几本关于螨目的旧专著来参加研讨会。

entries.en: A folding screen blocked our view of the display devoted to Accipitridae.
entries.zh: 一扇折叠屏风挡住了我们的视线，让我们看不到鹰科专题展区。

entries.en: The student added her drawings of Accipitriformes to the portfolio before submitting it.
entries.zh: 提交作品集前，学生把自己画的鹰形目鸟类图画加了进去。

entries.en: A pressed leaf slipped from the old book's chapter on Aceraceae.
entries.zh: 一片压制的叶子从那本旧书讲槭树科的章节里滑了出来。

entries.en: The photographer waited for the Acherontia to settle before adjusting the light.
entries.zh: 摄影师等那只鬼脸天蛾属蛾子停稳后，才调整灯光。

entries.en: The museum's drawing of Achoerodus was partly hidden behind a temporary notice.
entries.zh: 博物馆里那幅蓝唇鱼属动物图画，被一张临时告示挡住了一部分。

entries.en: The old monograph on Achras was bound with several unrelated botanical essays.
entries.zh: 那篇有关人心果属的旧专论，与几篇无关的植物学文章装订在一起。

entries.en: The Acinonyx sculpture was too heavy to move without another pair of hands.
entries.zh: 那座猎豹雕塑太重，没有别人搭把手就搬不动。

entries.en: A loose sheet of sketches of Acinos fell out of the old botanical volume.
entries.zh: 一张画着圣蓟属植物的散页，从那本旧植物学书中掉了出来。

entries.en: Several pages were missing from the museum's catalogue of Acipenseridae specimens.
entries.zh: 博物馆的鲟科标本目录缺了几页。

entries.meaningZh: 无刺孢子虫类〔旧分类名称〕
entries.en: The damaged volume contained several detailed drawings of Acnidosporidia, but its index was missing.
entries.zh: 那本受损的书里有几幅无刺孢子虫类的详细图画，但索引不见了。

entries.en: She borrowed an old botanical study of Acocanthera to compare its illustrations with her sketches.
entries.zh: 她借来一篇有关箭毒木属的旧植物学研究，想把其中的插图与自己的素描作比较。

entries.en: The gardener stopped beside the Acokanthera while we searched for the dropped camera cap.
entries.zh: 我们寻找掉落的镜头盖时，园丁在那株箭毒木属植物旁停了下来。

entries.en: During the seminar on Acoraceae, a sudden power cut left the lecturer holding a useless pointer.
entries.zh: 关于菖蒲科的研讨会上突然停电，讲者手里还拿着派不上用场的指示器。

entries.en: Rain had smudged her unfinished watercolour of Acorus before she could bring it indoors.
entries.zh: 她还没来得及把那幅未完成的菖蒲属植物水彩画拿进屋，雨水就把画弄花了。

entries.en: We postponed our discussion of Acrasiomycetes because the library had closed unexpectedly.
entries.zh: 图书馆意外关门了，我们于是推迟了有关聚粘菌纲的讨论。

entries.en: We examined the specimens of Acrididae after the curator unlocked the second cabinet.
entries.zh: 馆员打开第二个柜子后，我们观察了那些蝗科标本。

entries.en: The photographer returned without a clear picture of Acridotheres because her camera battery had failed.
entries.zh: 摄影师没能带回一张清晰的八哥属鸟类照片，因为相机电池出了问题。

entries.en: A child pointed excitedly at the enlarged photograph of Acris near the aquarium entrance.
entries.zh: 一个孩子兴奋地指着水族馆入口附近那张放大的蝗蛙属动物照片。

entries.en: The model of Acrobates had slipped behind the display stand during the move.
entries.zh: 搬运过程中，那个侏儒袋鼯模型滑到了陈列架后面。

entries.en: We waited beside an Acrocarpus until our guide returned with the lost backpack.
entries.zh: 我们在一株顶果木属植物旁等候，直到导游带着丢失的背包回来。

entries.en: Her recording of Acrocephalus was interrupted by someone dropping a metal bucket nearby.
entries.zh: 有人在附近掉落了一个金属桶，打断了她对苇莺属鸟类的录音。

entries.en: The large drawing of Acrocomia would not fit into my portfolio without folding.
entries.zh: 那幅刺茎椰子属植物的大画不折起来就放不进我的作品夹。

entries.en: He knelt beside the Actaea to recover a pencil that had rolled under its leaves.
entries.zh: 他在那株类叶升麻属植物旁跪下，想捡回滚到叶子下面的铅笔。

entries.en: The museum closed before she could finish sketching the specimen of Actias.
entries.zh: 她还没画完那件长尾水青蛾属标本，博物馆就闭馆了。

entries.en: Our tutor postponed the discussion of Actiniaria until everyone had received the missing illustrations.
entries.zh: 导师推迟了有关海葵目的讨论，等每个人都拿到缺失的插图后再进行。

entries.en: The botanist's notes on Actinidiaceae were found beneath a stack of unanswered letters.
entries.zh: 植物学家有关猕猴桃科的笔记，在一叠尚未回复的信件下面被找到了。

entries.en: A question about Actinomycetaceae kept the students talking after the lecture hall had emptied.
entries.zh: 报告厅的人都走空后，一个有关放线菌科的问题仍让学生们讨论不休。

entries.en: The chapter on Actinomycetales had come loose, so the librarian set it aside for repair.
entries.zh: 有关放线菌目的那一章散了，图书馆员便把它放到一边，准备修补。

entries.en: She requested a sharper scan of the plate illustrating Actinomyxidia in the old reference book.
entries.zh: 她请求提供那本旧参考书中放线虫目图版的更清晰扫描件。

entries.meaningZh: 辐管足类〔海参的旧分类名称〕
entries.en: The historian compared two old descriptions of Actinopoda while researching sea-cucumber classification.
entries.zh: 那位史学研究者研究海参分类时，比较了两份有关辐管足类的旧描述。

entries.en: The illustrations of Actinozoa caught his attention long before he began reading the accompanying text.
entries.zh: 他还没开始读配文，那些珊瑚动物的插图就已吸引了他的注意。

entries.en: The birdwatchers compared their photographs of Actitis while waiting for the rain to stop.
entries.zh: 观鸟者们一边等雨停，一边比较各自拍摄的矶鹬属鸟类照片。

entries.en: We borrowed a stronger magnifier to examine the preserved specimen of Adelges.
entries.zh: 我们借来一把放大倍数更高的放大镜，观察那件保存下来的球蚜属标本。

entries.en: Two pages of her report on Adelgidae were missing from the printer tray.
entries.zh: 打印机出纸盘里，她那份有关球蚜科的报告少了两页。

entries.en: The small Adelie in the photograph stood apart from the other penguins.
entries.zh: 照片中那只小阿德利企鹅与其他企鹅分开站着。

entries.en: She chose a shaded bench near the Adenanthera and opened her sketchbook.
entries.zh: 她选了那株海红豆属植物附近一张阴凉处的长椅，打开了素描本。

entries.meaningZh: 阿登诺塔〔羚羊类的旧属名〕
entries.en: The curator compared two old illustrations of Adenota before selecting one for the antelope display.
entries.zh: 馆员比较了两幅阿登诺塔属动物的旧插图，才选出其中一幅用于羚羊展览。

entries.en: An old volume on Adiantaceae fell open on the desk, revealing a pressed leaf.
entries.zh: 一本有关铁线蕨科的旧书在桌上摊开了，露出一片压制的叶子。

entries.en: The gardener asked us to move the ladder away from the Adlumia.
entries.zh: 园丁请我们把梯子挪开，离那株荷包藤属植物远一些。

entries.en: Her sketch of Aegiceras was ruined when a cup of tea overturned on the table.
entries.zh: 一杯茶在桌上翻倒，把她画的桐花树属植物素描毁了。

entries.en: The damaged sculpture of Aegypius needed a new stand before it could be displayed.
entries.zh: 那件受损的秃鹫属鸟类雕塑需要换一个底座，才能展出。

entries.en: We could not see the reconstruction of Aegyptopithecus until the crowd moved away.
entries.zh: 等人群散开后，我们才看到了那个埃及猿复原模型。

entries.en: A gust of wind scattered my notes beneath the pots of Aeonium.
entries.zh: 一阵风把我的笔记吹散，落到了莲花掌属植物的花盆下面。

entries.en: The artist added a second Aepyceros to balance the animals in her composition.
entries.zh: 画家又添画了一只黑斑羚属动物，使画面中的动物布局更加平衡。

entries.en: The gardener retrieved our ball from behind the young Aesculus.
entries.zh: 园丁从那株七叶树属幼树后面取回了我们的球。

entries.en: She set the pot of Aethionema on a stool so everyone could examine it.
entries.zh: 她把那盆岩芥菜属植物放到凳子上，好让大家观察。

entries.en: The illustration of Aethusa was too small for the class to see from the back row.
entries.zh: 那幅犬毒芹属植物插图太小，班里坐在后排的人看不清。

entries.en: The diver's photograph of Aetobatus was selected for the cover of the exhibition catalogue.
entries.zh: 潜水员拍摄的那张鹞鲼属动物照片被选作展览图录的封面。

entries.en: We left the greenhouse after the gardener finished showing us the Aframomum.
entries.zh: 园丁带我们看完那株非洲豆蔻属植物后，我们离开了温室。

entries.en: The farmer moved an Africander into the empty pen while we repaired the broken gate.
entries.zh: 我们修理坏掉的大门时，农夫把一头南非牛赶进了空栏。

entries.en: The bench beneath the Afrocarpus was still wet when we returned from lunch.
entries.zh: 我们吃完午饭回来时，那株非洲罗汉松属植物下面的长椅还湿着。

entries.en: A gust of wind blew her hat into the patch of Agalinis beside the path.
entries.zh: 一阵风把她的帽子吹进了小路旁那片阿加利尼斯属植物中。

entries.en: The exhibit on Agamidae drew so many visitors that the curator opened a second entrance.
entries.zh: 有关飞蜥科的展览吸引了很多游客，馆员于是又开放了一个入口。

entries.en: She waited for the Agapornis to settle before drawing the outline of its head.
entries.zh: 她等那只牡丹鹦鹉属鸟安静下来后，才开始画它头部的轮廓。
